builds.meaning: Pristine frozen scientific implementation/configuration; exact accepted source inventory and dependencies
Future instrumentation implementation, explicit instrumentation OFF
Same future implementation, explicit profile1-v1 ON

controlled_oracle: Compare B0/B1 and B1/B2 using identical zero and predeclared injected planner/codriver delay traces. Freeze the trace, fixtures, source diff, seed and SINGLE environment before results. Never require legacy wall/CPU timing values to be equal.
exact_channels: release sampled state; estimator history/value and target; tracker.previous and applied/pending command provenance
predicted handoff state and predicted previous control; predictor model/RK4 call sequence
preview values/progress; terminal matrix; warm/cold branch; complete pre-call X/U/slack state and packed NLP request
solver status/success, iteration count, objective/components, primal infeasibility, complete X/U/slacks and independent validity decisions
controller mutable solution/previous_control state before and after; rejected-solution reset
packet ID, source/release/sample/target/completion timestamps, valid_from, nominal nodes/states/controls, curvatures, gain times/gains, validity/reason
all physical integration intervals, inputs, internal stage/end states and native diagnostic decisions; no extra integration or validation calls
releases, busy opportunities, ready/waiting/accept/reject ownership, reserve/expiry, missed fixed deadlines, codriver requests/applications and original packet IDs
startup gating/prepositioning, failure/stop/censoring and fallback decisions
comparison: On the same locked backend require exact finite values, shapes, dtypes and serialized semantic values; where binary arrays are available compare bytes too. Do not wrap headings, interpolate traces or loosen model tolerances to conceal a difference. Any unexplained difference blocks progression.

volatile_exclusions.other_clock_metadata: Explicit enumerated codriver wall/CPU keys and new timing sidecar fields; resolve the complete field-path allowlist in the reviewed implementation test manifest. Record each exclusion and reason, never exclude an entire diagnostics/stats object.
volatile_exclusions.IPOPT: Only enumerated returned t_wall_*/t_proc_* statistic paths are timing exclusions; call counts, status, iterations, objective and feasibility remain compared.
volatile_exclusions.authority_timestamps: Never excluded under controlled timing. Measured observer probes have a separate comparison policy and cannot be used to waive controlled parity.

required_cases.assertion: B0/B1 exact semantic parity; no added recorder imports/allocations/clock calls when off; default CLI/profile/solver behavior unchanged.
B1/B2 cold startup and recurring warm preparations; exact solver requests, outputs, packets, chronology and RK4 sequence.
Fixed replay identical across builds; plant moves during pending solve, old valid packet continues 100 Hz tracking; compare stale application state, busy releases and skipped deadlines.
Due application before completion, then acceptance/expiry and codriver/release; old-source pending request identity survives handoff; no events added.

Approved test injections: prediction exception, solver exception/rejection, invalid optimizer output, packet validation and gain failure; original failure/exception unchanged and reached spans retained.
Late result, early waiting, insufficient reserve, stale/expired/rejected packet, fixed late miss, loss of authority and physically pending call at stop; none relabeled success.
Nested-tree reconciliation on each clock; monotonic endpoints, explicit not-reached/nulls, overflow/recorder failure, original exception not masked; sidecar cannot feed controller or authority.
Existing historical readers still work; new sidecar roundtrip preserves raw integer clocks, version/IDs/units and partial/censored reasons; all attempts retained.
Fresh process B0/B1/B2 comparisons report cold/warm cost, dispatch readiness deltas and any availability changes; no claim of measured trace or wall equality.

observer_assessment.predeclare: Exact fixtures, paired repetitions/order, resource cap and full duration/clock allowlist before Phase A execution authorization. Counts/budget remain unresolved; the 20-worker Phase B allocation is not borrowed.
comparisons: empty clock/span/append path vs actual instrumentation
detailed snapshots off vs on, if proposed; distinguish memory copies from clock-only tracing
observer_assessment.isolation: Fresh sequential SINGLE workers; identical declared construction and causal context, cold/warm paths separate. No reset to guessed warm state, order chosen by timing, parallel tests/rendering, new full-lap run or outcome-selected replacement.
observer_assessment.clock_calibration: Record monotonic implementation/resolution and empirical empty-span/skew distribution on the same backend before real probes; report raw paired deltas, maximum, sample count and run-level uncertainty. Do not subtract an optimistic calibration from reported costs.
observer_assessment.report: Retain all raw/negative paired deltas and statuses; report CPU/wall, exclusive residuals, full-call and dispatch-envelope changes, RSS and any changed readiness/ownership. Historical timings are not contemporaneous controls.
observer_assessment.acceptance: No invented negligible-overhead threshold. Engineering reviews complete observer evidence, attribution and exact source diff; unresolved tolerance/budget prevents execution or progression.

future_new_tests: Add focused recorder/default-off/real-solver/authority/partial-censoring tests in the separately authorized implementation. Expected injected negative cases are explicit fixtures; any new unexplained scientific failure stops the affected branch.
formal_verification: After Engineering Review and explicit authorization, run complete required regression/acceptance on the exact reviewed implementation SHA, audit artifacts and report VERIFIED_AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE only if required checks pass. Current static checks are not those passes.
